metadata.description: A curated directory of UI libraries with shadcn CLI support.
metadata.title: Awesome shadcn/ui

footer.note: Curated independently. Compatibility claims are not verified.

home.subtitle: Compare component registries, pricing models, source access, and project activity—all in one quiet directory.
home.title: Find the UI library that fits your next build.

directory.heading: Libraries that ship through the shadcn CLI

about.metadataDescription: How Awesome shadcn/ui selects, classifies, and maintains its directory.

classification.body: Source access, pricing, delivery type, access requirements, and use cases are summarized from public product information. A project can be free to browse while still selling premium libraries, so source and pricing are intentionally separate.
classification.heading: How information is classified

corrections.body: The catalog is maintained directly for now and does not accept submissions for new libraries. If an existing entry is wrong, please open a correction issue with the relevant public source.
corrections.heading: Corrections, not submissions

disclaimer.body: Inclusion is based on each project’s own public claims. We do not run installation commands, validate registry contents, or guarantee compatibility. Pricing and licensing can change; use the official site as the source of truth before adopting a library.
disclaimer.heading: A necessary disclaimer

github.body: Stars and the latest default-branch commit date are stored as a manual snapshot. Libraries without a public repository simply omit those values. Older snapshots are labeled as potentially outdated instead of being presented as live data.
github.heading: GitHub activity

scope.body: Awesome shadcn/ui lists UI libraries that publicly describe a way to install their work with the shadcn CLI or a compatible registry. The directory is organized at the library level, not the individual component level.
scope.heading: What belongs here

about.title: A quieter way to explore the shadcn ecosystem.
